name: Tan Wei Long
bio:
Tan Wei Long's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Trained as an aircraft mechanic, he found himself drawn to the precision and high-stakes environment of racing during a brief stint servicing private jets owned by racing team patrons. He quickly realized that composite technology offered a direct application of his existing skills, with the added excitement of constant innovation.

As a composite technician, Tan brings a meticulous eye and an unwavering dedication to quality. He believes that preparation is paramount, and he is known for his thoroughness. He's not afraid to voice his opinion and push for improvements, even if it means challenging established procedures. His colleagues respect his experience, even if they find his demanding nature a little overwhelming at times. He is a valuable asset to Allied Racing, providing a steady hand and a critical voice to their composite program.

physical.description: A sturdy man with a focused gaze and calloused hands that speak of years of dedicated work.

quirks: Insists on using only his own set of custom-modified tools.
Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against surfaces when deep in thought, much to the annoyance of others.
